mapper.select: select a.account_id accountId,a.id applicationId,a.status applicationStatus,a.admin_disabled adminDisabled, a.current_config_id currentConfigId,a.auth_epoch applicationEpoch,u.status accountStatus,u.del_flag accountDeleted, c.id configId,c.mode,c.avatar_version_id avatarVersionId, c.llm_relay_version_id llmRelayVersionId,c.asr_relay_version_id asrRelayVersionId,c.context_policy contextPolicy, vv.id voiceVersionId,vv.voice_code providerVoiceRef,vv.official_service_id officialServiceId, cast(json_unquote(json_extract(vv.official_config_snapshot,'$.revision')) as unsigned) officialServiceRevision from p_application a join sys_user u on u.user_id=a.account_id left join p_app_config c on c.id=coalesce(#{configId},a.current_config_id) and c.application_id=a.id and c.account_id=a.account_id left join p_voice_version vv on vv.id=c.voice_version_id and vv.service_type='OFFICIAL' where a.account_id=#{accountId} and a.id=#{applicationId} and a.purpose='USER'

select c.id configId,c.llm_relay_version_id llmRelayVersionId,c.asr_relay_version_id asrRelayVersionId,c.llm_model_id model, c.system_prompt systemPrompt,c.llm_parameters parameters,c.llm_capabilities capabilities, c.runtime_limits runtimeLimits,c.context_policy contextPolicy,a.current_policy currentPolicy from p_app_config c join p_resource_reference ref on ref.account_id=c.account_id and ref.holder_type='SESSION' and ref.holder_id=#{sessionId} and ref.resource_type='APP_CONFIG' and ref.resource_id=c.id and ref.state='CONFIRMED' join p_application a on a.id=c.application_id and a.account_id=c.account_id where c.id=#{configId} and c.account_id=#{accountId} and c.application_id=#{applicationId} and c.mode='CHAT'

select binding.skill_version_id from p_app_skill binding join p_resource_reference ref on ref.account_id=binding.account_id and ref.holder_type='SESSION' and ref.holder_id=#{sessionId} and ref.resource_type='SKILL_VERSION' and ref.resource_id=binding.skill_version_id and ref.state='CONFIRMED' where binding.account_id=#{accountId} and binding.app_config_id=#{configId} and binding.enabled=1 order by binding.sort_order,binding.id
select a.current_config_id currentConfigId,a.status,a.admin_disabled adminDisabled from p_application a where a.account_id=#{accountId} and a.id=#{applicationId} and a.purpose='USER' for update
select max_sessions from p_account_limit where account_id=#{accountId} for update

select count(distinct holder_id) from p_resource_reference where account_id=#{accountId} and holder_type='SESSION' and holder_id!=#{sessionId} and resource_type='APP_CONFIG' and state in ('RESERVED','CONFIRMED')

select count(*) from p_application a join p_app_config c on c.id=#{configId} and c.application_id=a.id and c.account_id=a.account_id join p_avatar_version av on av.id=c.avatar_version_id join p_avatar avatar on avatar.id=av.avatar_id join p_voice_version vv on vv.id=c.voice_version_id join p_voice voice on voice.id=vv.voice_id join p_official_service official on official.id=vv.official_service_id where a.id=#{applicationId} and a.account_id=#{accountId} and av.status='PUBLISHED' and avatar.status in ('PUBLISHED','UNLISTED') and voice.visibility='OFFICIAL' and voice.status in ('PUBLISHED','UNLISTED') and vv.service_type='OFFICIAL' and official.capability='TTS' and official.status='ACTIVE' and (c.mode='SPEAK_ONLY' or c.mode='CHAT' and exists ( select 1 from p_relay_version rv join p_relay_service rs on rs.id=rv.relay_service_id where rv.id=c.llm_relay_version_id and rs.account_id=a.account_id and rs.status='ACTIVE' and rs.admin_disabled=0 and json_unquote(json_extract(rv.capabilities,'$.llm'))='true' and (rs.grant_mode='ALL_ACCOUNT_APPS' or exists ( select 1 from p_relay_grant g where g.relay_service_id=rs.id and g.application_id=a.id and g.status='ACTIVE' and json_contains(g.scopes,'"LLM"'))))) and (c.asr_relay_version_id is null or exists ( select 1 from p_relay_version rv join p_relay_service rs on rs.id=rv.relay_service_id where rv.id=c.asr_relay_version_id and rs.account_id=a.account_id and rs.status='ACTIVE' and rs.admin_disabled=0 and json_unquote(json_extract(rv.capabilities,'$.asr'))='true' and (rs.grant_mode='ALL_ACCOUNT_APPS' or exists ( select 1 from p_relay_grant g where g.relay_service_id=rs.id and g.application_id=a.id and g.status='ACTIVE' and json_contains(g.scopes,'"ASR"'))))) and not exists ( select 1 from p_app_skill binding join p_skill_version sv on sv.id=binding.skill_version_id join p_skill skill on skill.id=sv.skill_id where binding.app_config_id=c.id and binding.enabled=1 and skill.status not in ('PUBLISHED','UNLISTED'))
mapper.insert: insert into p_resource_reference (id,created_at,updated_at,account_id,holder_type,holder_id,operation_id,resource_type,resource_id,state,next_check_at) values (uuid_short(),utc_timestamp(3),utc_timestamp(3),#{accountId},'SESSION',#{sessionId},#{operationId},#{resourceType},#{resourceId},'RESERVED',date_add(utc_timestamp(3),interval 1 minute)) on duplicate key update updated_at=values(updated_at),state=if(state='RELEASED',state,'RESERVED'),operation_id=if(state='RELEASED',operation_id,values(operation_id))
mapper.update: update p_resource_reference set state='CONFIRMED',confirmed_at=utc_timestamp(3),next_check_at=null,updated_at=utc_timestamp(3) where account_id=#{accountId} and holder_type='SESSION' and holder_id=#{sessionId} and operation_id=#{operationId} and state='RESERVED'

update p_resource_reference set state='RELEASED',released_at=utc_timestamp(3),next_check_at=null,updated_at=utc_timestamp(3) where account_id=#{accountId} and holder_type='SESSION' and holder_id=#{sessionId} and operation_id=#{operationId} and state in ('RESERVED','CONFIRMED')
mapper.select: select count(*) from p_resource_reference where account_id=#{accountId} and holder_type='SESSION' and holder_id=#{sessionId} and operation_id=#{operationId} and state='CONFIRMED'
